Hi Rishi,

Please find attached Novacorp's initial redlines to the MSA and the associated Order Form. Our primary concerns are the confidentiality carve-outs and the publicity/reference rights sections. In short:

- We cannot agree to broad press or marketing rights without prior written approval on each use.
- Logo use needs to be limited to specific materials and approval by our brand team.
- Reference/lists should be opt-in; we want explicit permission each time.

We highlighted suggested language in the attached PDF (Novacorp_Redlines_MSA_OrderForm_v1.pdf). Can you confirm Redwood's standard approach here and let us know your legal/ops timeline for a response? Novacorp would like to keep this on a tight cadence — ideally a final sign-off within two weeks.

Thanks Marta / Novacorp Legal — received and appreciate the clarity. Looping in our legal lead (Lauren) and PM (Dev) so we can coordinate quickly.

Quick notes from Redwood's side:
- We generally require prior written approval for press releases; our standard is a 10 business day review window. We're open to a shorter window for joint announcements.
- For logo/reference rights we typically allow: (a) inclusion on a customer list on our website, and (b) use in sales decks with brand guidelines compliance. All uses are subject to a right of prior approval.
- For customer quotes or case studies we request a single review pass and allow a maximum of two rounds of edits.

I've attached a short proposed paragraph that would sit in the MSA's publicity section that we think is a reasonable compromise. It limits press to written notice + review; allows listing on Redwood's customer page and sales materials; and preserves an explicit opt-in for deeper case study materials.

Proposed (inline):
"Neither party shall issue any public announcement, press release, or marketing communication regarding the relationship without prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld; Redwood may include Customer in a non-detailed customer list on its website and in sales materials subject to Customer's brand guidelines and prior review of any Customer-identifying quotes or case study text within 5 business days."

Attachments: Redwood_Proposed_Press_Language.docx

Can Novacorp confirm whether a 5 business day review for quotes/case studies is acceptable and whether the site/sales materials language addresses your brand team's concerns? If yes I'll ask Lauren to finalize a redline for signature.

-Rishi

Hi Rishi / team — thanks for the quick reply and the proposed language. Novacorp is generally aligned but asks for a couple of narrow clarifications to protect their PR cadence: 

1) The customer list/web/sales use is acceptable in principle, but Novacorp requires explicit opt-in for being identified in external-facing case studies or vendor blog posts (not just a quote).
2) For any quote to be used publicly, Novacorp requests pre-approval of the exact quote; a 5 business day window is workable but they would like the language to state that approval "shall not be unreasonably withheld."
3) For press releases, Novacorp requests an allowance for a one-time joint announcement in coordination with a product launch, provided both parties agree in writing (in addition to the standard review window).

Ethan attached a marked-up version of the MSA redline reflecting these points (Novacorp_Redlines_MSA_OrderForm_v1.pdf — updated). Also, Novacorp's brand team asks that any logo usage reference the brand guidelines document and that we include a requirement to discontinue use upon written request.

Would Redwood accept: (a) explicit opt-in language for case studies, (b) the 5 business day approval window with "not unreasonably withheld" language, and (c) a mutual approval clause for one-time joint announcements? If so, Novacorp is comfortable moving to signature and can route to DocuSign.

Attachments: Novacorp_Redlines_MSA_OrderForm_v1.pdf

Best,
Ethan Price

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Ethan / Marta. This aligns well. To be explicit, Redwood will accept the following compromise for the publicity and logo/reference sections:

- Press releases and public announcements: prior written consent required; Redwood shall provide draft copy and Customer shall have 10 business days to review. For joint product launch announcements the parties may agree to a one-time joint announcement with a 5 business day coordinated review and mutual written approval.

- Customer listing / sales materials: Redwood may list Customer on a non-detailed customer page on its website and include Customer in sales materials. Any use of Customer-identifying quotes or case study text requires Customer's written approval which shall not be unreasonably withheld; Customer will respond within 5 business days.

- Logo use: Redwood may use Customer logos in accordance with Customer's brand guidelines. All logo artwork and usage examples will be submitted for Customer approval prior to first use; Customer may require discontinuation upon written notice.

I've updated the MSA redline to reflect this compromise and uploaded to the shared folder. If Novacorp confirms, we can push the final MSA + Order Form to DocuSign and target signature this week.
